title: Excellent, knowledgeable, and friendly guide.
text:
The guide was an exceptional person; she mentioned that she was from Romania and speaks perfect Spanish. If I remember correctly, her name is 
Anabel. 
She has a lot of knowledge; above all, she was attentive, waiting for us to drink water, and she also talked quite a bit about the history of the Alhambra. 
Very friendly. She also provided interesting facts about the Alhambra. Highly recommended. 
We bought our tickets directly on the Alhambra website, and we found the guide at the entrance; we hired her right there.
author: X5863IYlauram

title: Outstanding private tour at the Alhambra
text: Bea was extraordinary. Speaking in perfect English she showed us all the nooks and crannies of the Alhambra while weaving the history and architecture in seamlessly.  You couldn’t find a better guide
author: Dream12293701217

title: Esther was great!!
text: Esther was an amazing and very knowledgeable tour guide. Our grandmother was on the tour and Esther made sure she took her time to allow for our grandmother to feel comfortable.
author: soccermomabc123

title: Alhambra tour
text:
I am a expat living in Malaga .  Visited Granada with girlfriends from the United States. 
Wonderful tour of the Alhambra.  My fiends and I enjoyed this tour offered by Esther .  She was very knowledgeable and really brought the grounds to life . Her love for her city and its culture is evident.  I look forward to other tours with Esther when I return to Granada.
author: F7636VLjoycee
